cost.scope: Native local-checkout two/32-variant consumers, isolated build caches, existing module cache, one sequential sample per generation/build state, three fresh gopls sessions per operation, five runtime samples. Handwritten dispatch shares parser, strict shape and snapshot ownership; lifecycle costs are reported separately.

fixes: Retain nested callback panic/Goexit classification at the shared callback boundary.
Bound re-encoded union payload bytes after JSON escaping.
Reject empty-name unknown properties in ordinary objects after sharing object validation.
Document manifest format 2 and strict older-client unknown-tag rejection.
Report benchmark wire size after b.Loop resets timing and custom metrics.
Refresh generated consumer output after earlier source position changes.
interruptions: First full gate ran out of disk space during vet.
Second full gate was terminated for user-requested Go cache cleanup.
Third full gate passed framework and consumer tests but failed final consumer generation freshness; regeneration and the benchmark metrics fix precede the final gate.
limits: Five runtime samples; one sequential sample per generation/build state and three fresh editor sessions per operation.
Local-checkout consumers use isolated build caches and existing module downloads; these are not packaged-release or application-throughput claims.
Native snapshot construction/access costs are reported separately from strict wire dispatch.
Temporary measurement compiler caches are cleared after each completed profile; evidence and source are retained.
T03–T07 and the integrated final audit remain outstanding.

from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess

os.umask(0o077)
root=Path('/Users/weiloon/Projects/rust-go/Foundry-Go')
output=root/'.cache/t-series/t02/cost-r1'
output.mkdir()
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('release_measurement',root/'tools/measure-release.py')
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(m)
runner=m.Runner(output,600)
env={k:os.environ[k] for k in ('PATH','HOME','TMPDIR','LANG','LC_ALL') if k in os.environ}
env.update(GOENV='off',GOTOOLCHAIN='local',GOWORK='off',GOFLAGS='-mod=readonly',GOPROXY='off',DEVELOPER_DIR='/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools')
env['PATH']='/usr/local/go/bin:'+env['PATH']
go='/usr/local/go/bin/go';foundry=output/'foundry'
runner.run('prepare-generator',[go,'build','-o',foundry,'./cmd/foundry'],root,env)
benchmarks={}
benchmarks['dispatch']=runner.run('dispatch-benchmarks',[go,'test','-run','^$','-bench','^BenchmarkUnionDispatch$','-benchmem','-count=5','./contract'],root,env)
benchmarks['lifecycle']=runner.run('lifecycle-benchmarks',[go,'test','-run','^$','-bench','^BenchmarkUnionLifecycle$','-benchmem','-count=5','./unions'],root/'tests/fixtures/consumer',env)
module=(root/'tests/fixtures/consumer/go.mod').read_text().replace('=> ../../..','=> '+str(root)).replace('=> ../plugin_base','=> '+str(root/'tests/fixtures/plugin_base')).replace('=> ../plugin_dep','=> '+str(root/'tests/fixtures/plugin_dep'))
profiles={}
for count in (2,32):
 name=str(count);consumer=output/('variants-'+name);consumer.mkdir()
 (consumer/'go.mod').write_text(module);(consumer/'go.sum').write_bytes((root/'tests/fixtures/consumer/go.sum').read_bytes())
 source=consumer/'action.go'
 text='''package unioncost
//foundry:dto
type Payload struct {Value string `json:"value"`}
//foundry:union name=Action discriminator=kind
type ActionVariants struct {
'''+''.join(' Variant'+str(i)+' Payload `union:"variant_'+str(i)+'"`\n' for i in range(count))+'''}
func New()(Action,error){return ActionFromVariant0(Payload{Value:"sample"})}
func Inspect(input Action)string{payload,ok:=input.Variant0();if !ok{return ""};return payload.Value}
'''
 source.write_text(text)
 runner.run(name+'-format',['/usr/local/go/bin/gofmt','-w',source],consumer,env)
 original=source.read_text()
 generation_env=dict(env,GOCACHE=str(output/(name+'-generation-cache')))
 generate=[foundry,'generate','--recursive','--dir',consumer]
 runner.run(name+'-generation-cold',generate,consumer,generation_env)
 initial=m.generated_inventory(consumer)
 runner.run(name+'-generation-unchanged',generate,consumer,generation_env)
 if initial!=m.generated_inventory(consumer):raise ValueError('unchanged generation mutated output')
 build_env=dict(env,GOCACHE=str(output/(name+'-build-cache')))
 runner.run(name+'-build-cold',[go,'build','./...'],consumer,build_env)
 runner.run(name+'-build-unchanged',[go,'build','./...'],consumer,build_env)
 marker='type Payload struct {';assert original.count(marker)==1
 source.write_text(original.replace(marker,marker+'\n Revision string `json:"revision"`'))
 runner.run(name+'-format-edit',['/usr/local/go/bin/gofmt','-w',source],consumer,env)
 runner.run(name+'-generation-edited',generate,consumer,generation_env)
 edited=m.generated_inventory(consumer)
 if initial==edited:raise ValueError('field edit did not reach metadata')
 runner.run(name+'-build-edited',[go,'build','./...'],consumer,build_env)
 editor=[];text=source.read_text();editor_env=dict(build_env,GOPLSCACHE=str(output/(name+'-gopls-cache')))
 for round_number in range(3):
  for operation,prefix,symbol in (('complete','','ActionFromVariant0'),('hover','input.','Variant0')):
   line,column=m.position(text,prefix,symbol,operation)
   command=[foundry,'agent',operation,'--workspace',consumer,'--file','action.go','--line',str(line),'--column',str(column),'--gopls',root/'bin/gopls','--timeout','120s']
   payload=json.loads(runner.run(name+'-gopls-'+operation+'-'+str(round_number+1),command,consumer,editor_env))
   m.validate_editor(payload,operation,symbol)
   editor.append(dict(operation=operation,round=round_number+1,timing=payload['timing']))
 if source.read_text()!=text:raise ValueError('editor modified source')
 profiles[name]=dict(variants=count,generated_initial=initial,generated_edited=edited,editor=editor,initial_source=original,edited_source=text)
 # Retain reproducible source/logs/results, then release disposable compiler caches.
 reclaimed=0
 for cache in (Path(generation_env['GOCACHE']),Path(build_env['GOCACHE'])):
  if cache.is_symlink() or not (cache/'README').read_text().startswith('This directory holds cached build artifacts from the Go build system.'):
   raise ValueError('unexpected measurement build cache')
  before=int(subprocess.check_output(['du','-sk',str(cache)],text=True).split()[0])*1024
  subprocess.run([go,'clean','-cache'],env=dict(env,GOCACHE=str(cache)),check=True)
  after=int(subprocess.check_output(['du','-sk',str(cache)],text=True).split()[0])*1024
  reclaimed+=before-after
 profiles[name]['disposable_build_cache_reclaimed_bytes']=reclaimed
m.write_json(output/'report.json',dict(scope='Native local-checkout two/32-variant consumers, isolated build caches, existing module cache, one sequential sample per generation/build state, three fresh gopls sessions per operation, five runtime samples. Handwritten dispatch shares parser, strict shape and snapshot ownership; lifecycle costs are reported separately.',profiles=profiles,benchmarks=benchmarks,commands=runner.results))
print(json.dumps({'report':str(output/'report.json')}),flush=True)
